how_its_made: The project uses a react front end, various other libraries, and aztec shielded transactions to perform private uniswap transactions. The project also uses Optimism L2 transactions to perform swaps with uniswap as an additional option, and uses textile to store snapshots with the use of storage-js on polygon.
